input_results_policy: All numbers use original result.json values and observed submission counts; no AI-recommended relabeling or rescoring is applied.

units.sample_sd: statistics.stdev with ddof=1; null for n<2
units.success_denominator: status == completed only; None success on error is not a failure vote
units.submissions_mean: all observed QUESTION+FINAL submissions in completed runs, including unsuccessful finals; not questions-to-success
units.A_vs_B: A_source separately; B_target_or_standalone includes CL targets and solo/MAS target solves, stratified by task family and cohort
units.no_inferential_causality: Descriptive summaries only; version, cohort, prompt/controller, A-prefix reuse, recovery and technical failure differences constrain causal comparisons.

key_paper_conclusions.claim: All 131 physical archives and 12,631 submission reviews are fully source-consistency verified; AI semantic review remains distinct from human gold.

There are 130 unique experimental observations and 12,531 unique submissions, rather than 131 independent repeats. One TS033 A history is copied across legacy round2 and extra2; the raw trajectory hashes differ only because answer-reveal bookkeeping was appended.
key_paper_conclusions.limitation: Raw whole-file uniqueness alone is insufficient to establish independence.

key_paper_conclusions.claim: All 93 completed CL B target runs fail the original completion criterion, although graded partial scores vary across conditions.
key_paper_conclusions.limitation: Do not pool their partial scores into one transfer-effect estimate: targets, frozen Host versions, scoring annotations, controllers and source designs differ.

key_paper_conclusions.claim: Target TS038 comparisons have 7 successes among 23 completed runs; two distinct technical errors are retained in the audit and excluded from the completed denominator.
key_paper_conclusions.limitation: Small condition cells and different coverage-v2/v3 and Host versions prevent a universal MAS or review advantage claim.

key_paper_conclusions.claim: Condition ordering changes between cohorts: local CL score means are answer_only .4625, direct .375, session .275; v17 means are direct .555, session .41333, answer_only .40833. No CL cohort demonstrates complete-solution success.
key_paper_conclusions.limitation: These are descriptive final-score comparisons. V17 shares five direct controls across three A designs; never count those controls fifteen times.

key_paper_conclusions.claim: Review-assisted solo succeeds 2/2 in the initial local TS038 reference cohort and 0/2 in the later cohort; the available data do not establish a repeatable intervention effect.
key_paper_conclusions.limitation: Later repeats use a different recovery/controller cohort; the combined 2/4 is descriptive, not an isolated causal effect.

key_paper_conclusions.claim: A score of 1.0 and complete=true are different outcomes under these frozen coverage rubrics.
key_paper_conclusions.limitation: Use original success/complete for success rates and retain score as a separate measure; no AI suspicion has been used to rescore these outcomes.

key_paper_conclusions.claim: Fixed A histories and inherited sessions are repeated exposures rather than new A observations; the imported historical direct baseline also needs provenance-based deduplication if its standalone archive is added.
key_paper_conclusions.limitation: Names such as r01/r02 alone do not prove independent sampling; source and timestamped history provenance controls the counting unit.

task_family_descriptive_totals.note: Cross-version totals document coverage only; they are not a pooled effect estimate.
